title: Youtube duet: Miles Davis improvising on LCD Soundsystem
summary: A mashup that plays a Miles Davis improvisation video alongside an LCD Soundsystem clip with no editing, so the two seem to perform together. It also became known for an affectionate mouse cursor moving along.
why: Commenters repeatedly call it a favorite and a mind-blowing introduction to jazz.

quote.text: which served as one of my most memorable early introductions to jazz
